strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: per 1 kg of liquid epoxy resin, the column header of Tab. 31.2; allocation: None stated; Tab. 31.2 has a single output, 'epoxy resin, liquid, disaggregated data, at plant, 1.00E+0 kg'.; 9 of 9 inputs carry a printed amount, 0 a printed range, 0 no number in the report. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: Tab. 31.2 is a partial disaggregation, not a full unit process: Boustead's cumulative energy and waste have been pulled out into technosphere exchanges (electricity, heavy fuel oil, natural gas furnace, tap water, two disposal services, transport, chemical plant), but the chemistry has not - there is no epichlorohydrin and no bisphenol A line, although the dataset's own ecoSpold technology field says 'Production from epichlorohydrin and bisphenol-A' and BAFU carries unit processes for both ('Epichlorohydrin, from hypochlorination of allyl chloride, at plant' and 'Bisphenol A, powder, at plant'). What is left in the elementary flows below - 1.8 kg of rock salt, 0.98 kg of chloride to water, 0.38 kg of sodium to water - is the chlor-alkali chain of the epichlorohydrin still sitting in the direct flows.
1200 kg of sand per kg of resin (see the item note) is transcribed as printed and is almost certainly wrong in the source.

Six of the eight waste-treatment services that the aggregated dataset carries (spoil from coal mining, incineration residue, hazardous waste to underground deposit, facilities chemical production, plastics to sanitary landfill, wood to incineration, tailings) appear in Tab. 31.1 but not in Tab. 31.2, which keeps only the two municipal-solid-waste lines.
No land use and no soil emissions, as chapter 31 says for the whole Boustead family.
The report gives no uncertainty ('Uncertainty for LCI results cannot be determined' on every line).
skipped_items: Water, unspecified natural origin: no flow chosen (The deterministic keyword search returned no candidate at all for this phrase (every word of it is a stop-word-like token in the flow index), so there is nothing to choose from. The intended flow is EF 3.1 'Water' in 'Renewable material resources from water' - it is visible in the candidate list of the sibling item 'Water, river' - but the rules forbid picking a candidate that was not offered for this item, so it is recorded as missing. 6.10E-3 m3 per kg is lost.)

Hydrogen fluoride: no flow chosen (none of the offered candidates is hydrogen fluoride in an air compartment: the list holds hydrogen fluoride only to soil and to water (long-term), plus hydrogen, tritium and fluoride ion. Rather than release 5E-7 kg of HF into the wrong compartment or map it to a different substance, it is left unmapped.)

Methane, chlorotrifluoro-, CFC-13: no flow chosen (the deterministic search returned no candidate at all for this name, so there is nothing to choose; 8E-6 kg of CFC-13 per kg of resin is lost, which matters more than its mass suggests because it is a very high-GWP halocarbon.)
